evidence: Nestled in the heart of Hanoi’s Old Quarter, Hang Can Street, known locally as Phố Hàng Cân, stands as a testament to the enduring commercial heritage of Vietnam’s imperial capital. Historically, this bustling thoroughfare was home to skilled artisans who crafted and traded cân ta and cân tiểu ly, traditional balance beams used to weigh precious metals such as gold and silver, as well as药材北，从这些精细的平衡杆中诞生了这条街道朴实无华的名字——Hang Can。尽管铜制天平的身影已逐渐淡出历史舞台，这条街的生命力依然旺盛，通过包装和各种类型的纸张贸易继续繁荣着。日复一日，游客和当地居民熙熙攘攘地穿梭于人群之中，挑选色彩斑斓的纸张堆或悠闲地在人行道上品尝冰茶，欣赏繁忙的街道景象。在这交织的空间中漫步，人们的心灵会突然被一种难以言喻的宁静与怀旧之情所充满。凝视那些覆盖着青苔的老房子，体验到一种深邃的平衡感，帮助每个人深刻理解Tràng An人民商业文化中的正直与标准。

Nestled in the heart of Hanoi’s Old Quarter, Hang Can Street, known locally as Phố Hàng Cân, stands as a testament to the enduring commercial heritage of Vietnam’s imperial capital. Historically, this bustling thoroughfare was home to skilled artisans who crafted and traded cân ta and cân tiểu ly, traditional balance beams used to weigh precious metals such as gold and silver, as well as medicinal herbs.
